content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account access today?
Hi, I need to reset my password for the company portal.
Of course. Please start by clicking the 'Forgot Password' link on the portal login page.
I clicked it. It's asking for my username and company email.
Go ahead and enter your employee username and your work email address. Once done, click 'Submit'.
Alright, I entered them. Now it's prompting for my employee ID to verify.
Please enter your employee ID number in the verification field. This step confirms your identity.
Done. Now it says a verification code was sent to my email.
Great. Check your inbox for a message from 'Company Security' and type the code you received into the portal.
Just entered the code. It let me set a new password. Thanks for your help!
